nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Builds @opencode-ai/sdk clients bound to a specific server connection, generating Basic auth headers from username/password credentials and encoding/decoding credential tokens.

nodes.name: authFromToken
nodes.summary: Decodes a Basic auth token back into its username and password components.

nodes.name: createSdkForServer
nodes.summary: Instantiates an SDK client pointed at a specific server URL, injecting a Basic Authorization header when credentials are present and merging any custom fetch config headers.

nodes.name: session-title.ts
nodes.summary: Strips the auto-generated timestamp suffix from default session titles ('New session - 2026-01-01T...Z' becomes 'New session') for display.

nodes.name: sessionTitle
nodes.summary: Matches an auto-generated title pattern and returns just the label part, passing through custom titles unchanged.

nodes.name: solid-dnd.tsx
nodes.summary: Drag-and-drop helpers for solid-dnd: extracts draggable IDs from custom drag events and exports axis-constraint transformers (ConstrainDragXAxis / ConstrainDragYAxis) that lock dragging to a single axis.

nodes.name: getDraggableId
nodes.summary: Extracts the draggable node id from a solid-dnd drag event object.

nodes.name: createAxisConstraint
nodes.summary: Builds a drag transformer that zeroes movement along one axis, registering it with the drag-drop context when the constrained node starts dragging and removing it on drag end or cleanup.

nodes.name: sound.ts
nodes.summary: Plays notification sounds by lazily loading audio assets discovered via Vite's import.meta.glob, caching resolved URLs and exposing SOUND_OPTIONS plus playSoundById for the settings UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses import.meta.glob so sound assets are code-split and only fetched on first play, with a Promise cache to avoid repeated dynamic imports.

nodes.name: getLoads
nodes.summary: Maps sound file paths discovered by import.meta.glob to lazy loader functions keyed by sound id.

nodes.name: soundSrc
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the URL for a sound id by invoking its lazy loader, falling back to the default sound when the id is unknown.

nodes.name: playSound
nodes.summary: Plays an audio element for a source URL, pausing any currently playing sound first and swallowing autoplay-policy rejections.

nodes.name: terminal-websocket-url.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the WebSocket URL for a terminal session from an HTTP base URL, converting the scheme, carrying query parameters, and appending Basic auth credentials when the server requires them.

nodes.name: terminalWebSocketURL
nodes.summary: Converts an HTTP(S) server URL plus session parameters into an authenticated ws(s):// WebSocket URL for the terminal connection.

nodes.name: terminal-writer.ts
nodes.summary: Batching writer for terminal output: coalesces queued chunks and flushes them through a schedulable callback with error settling, preventing interleaved partial writes to the xterm display.

nodes.name: terminalWriter
nodes.summary: Creates a coalescing writer around a terminal write callback: batches pushed chunks, flushes joined output through the provided scheduler, settles write errors, and lets callers await completion via flush().

nodes.name: time.ts
nodes.summary: Formats timestamps as localized relative-time strings (seconds, minutes, hours, or days ago) through a translation callback.

nodes.name: getRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Formats a date as a localized relative-time string ('5m ago') by bucketing the elapsed duration and delegating each unit label to a translation callback.

nodes.name: uuid.ts
nodes.summary: Generates RFC 4122 UUIDs via crypto.randomUUID with a Math.random-based fallback for environments lacking the Web Crypto API.

nodes.name: uuid
nodes.summary: Returns crypto.randomUUID() when available, otherwise concatenates random hex slices into a UUID-shaped fallback string.

nodes.name: worktree.ts
nodes.summary: Module-level registry tracking worktree setup state (pending/ready/failed) per directory, with promise-based wait() so components can await worktree readiness exactly once.
nodes.languageNotes: A const-object singleton (Worktree) built from Map-based state plus deferred-promise waiters rather than a class; waiter promises are shared per directory until resolved.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type declaration that pulls in the sst environment types for the app package.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by SST (marked do-not-edit); references the repo-root sst-env.d.ts via a triple-slash path.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite configuration for the app package: dev server on 0.0.0.0:3000, esnext build target with sourcemaps, optional Sentry release/source-map upload when env tokens are set, and the desktop plugin pipeline from vite.js.

nodes.name: vite.js
nodes.summary: Vite plugin pipeline for the SolidJS app: configures the '@' path alias and ES worker format, inlines the theme preload script into index.html at build time, and registers Tailwind CSS v4 and the solid plugin.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain JS (not TS) so Vite can load it without transformation; the theme-preload plugin inlines oc-theme-preload.js into the HTML to avoid a flash of wrong theme.
